convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iMA, iMACD). Simple crossover entry with position averaging. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic. Fixed lot sizing with averaging logic.

other_exits: Position averaging: adds to existing position when signal reoccurs, effectively averaging entry price rather than closing on reversal

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Initial entry uses fixed lots; subsequent entries on same signal direction use additional fixed lots for position averaging, up to MaxAverages positions in same direction

custom_logic_notes: This EA implements position averaging (pyramiding). When the fast/slow EMA crossover and MACD confirm a direction, it opens a position. On subsequent new bars where the signal persists, it adds another position in the same direction (averaging) up to MaxAverages. SL/TP apply to each individual position. The net SL/TP for the averaged group becomes effectively different from the per-position settings. Signal reversal closes all same-direction positions before opening opposite direction.
python_conversion_notes: Position averaging requires tracking multiple open positions per direction. Each position has its own SL/TP calculated from its entry price. On signal reversal, close all positions of the opposite direction first, then open new direction. The new_bar_guard uses IsNewBar() pattern - track previous bar time. Digit adjustment: multiply SL/TP pip values by 10 when symbol has 5 digits or _Point < 0.001. MACD confirmation must check both main vs signal line direction. The averaging limit (MaxAverages) must be checked against count of open positions in same direction before adding.
